concepts.name: Enchanted Ink
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game art direction concept board, landscape composition.
Primary request: First of two alternative visual styles for a browser 2D top-down portrait wizard action exploration game with wands, runes, round combat arenas connected by corridors, Forest Cave Library biomes. Create a polished art director board titled "01 / ENCHANTED INK". Warm storybook hand-painted 2D, simplified silhouettes, ink outlines, paper grain, mossy ruins, brass rune devices. Attractive and practically achievable small indie game art.
Composition: left half a large upright 9:16 believable top-down GAMEPLAY mockup, not isometric: little hooded wizard with clearly visible wand, spacious circular forest arena, 3 distinct enemy silhouettes, small readable flame projectile, upward path. Modest HUD health/mana top, floating joystick lower left and two wand/rune slots lower right. All in-game text English. Right half three small environment studies Forest / Cave / Library, small wizard and wand/rune detail studies. Bottom clean palette strip with six large swatches and exactly these printed codes: #182C28 #496B4A #B8C88D #E9DDBB #C58A45 #EF795E.
Color palette: deep pine shadows, sage foliage, pale moss floor, parchment UI, brass loot, coral hostile warnings. Floor light enough to read dark characters; magic is the sharpest luminous accent. Atmospheric but uncluttered, no photorealism, no 3D, no existing franchise characters. Editorial concept sheet, elegant legible typography, balanced whitespace. Show actual color swatches.

concepts.name: Prism Ruins
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: second alternative game visual direction board.
Primary request: Create polished concept board titled "02 / PRISM RUINS" for 2D top-down portrait browser wizard action exploration game, wands runes round arenas joined by corridors, Forest Cave Library. Strongly distinct art direction: crisp flat geometric 2D shapes, limited stepped shading, dark navy backgrounds, large readable silhouettes and controlled luminous cyan/amethyst magic, sophisticated mysterious arcane atmosphere. No pixel art, no painterly texture. Achievable vector-like indie art, not sci-fi and not cyberpunk.
Composition: left half large 9:16 upright GAMEPLAY mockup true top-down overhead view with no horizon: small hooded wizard with wand on spacious circular cave arena, clearly visible 3 enemies, a bright cyan charged spell and a coral outlined danger zone. Environment subdued, navigable floor separate from walls, sparse geometric crystals at edges. HUD health/mana top, mode control lower left and wand/rune slots lower right, all labels English. Right half three environment thumbnails titled Forest, Cave, Library showing same style: bioluminescent dark forest, crystalline cave, occult geometric library. Small wizard silhouettes and wand/rune studies. Bottom six clear color swatches with exact printed HEX: #101525 #28354A #52647C #59E1E8 #A78BFA #FF786C. Text and neutral UI in #EEEAF7.
Lighting and color: mostly muted navy/slate terrain, cyan player magic, lilac portals/runes, coral danger. Glow only near magic. Shape-first art; rings triangular sigils clean compact HUD. High visual readability on mobile, polished editorial board, ample hierarchy. No photorealism, no 3D render, no existing game references, no extra invented gameplay systems.
